exchangeRate.annualObservation: last available ECB reference rate in December
exchangeRate.source: ECB EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A from 1999; OECD CCUSSP01FRM650N euro-equivalent history before 1999
exchangeRate.historicalConvention: The OECD series expresses the legacy French-currency history as an euro-equivalent exchange rate, avoiding a discontinuity from French francs to euros.
exchangeRate.francSeriesSource: FRED EXFRUS from 1971; derived using the fixed 1 EUR = 6.55957 FRF conversion before 1971

inflation.index: French CPI, all households, all items
inflation.source: OECD CPALTT01FRM657N for 1960-1998; INSEE series 001759970 from 1999
inflation.historicalMethod: Monthly OECD rates compounded over January-December

notes: These files are data-only preparation; application code does not consume them yet.
The pre-1999 history is an euro-equivalent reconstruction based on the OECD series, with a separate FRF/USD file for traceability.
